summary: Frontend validation of RoofSpan 'Purchasing, Pricing & Customer Output Completion' phase. Found and fixed one critical bug (missing Button import in Reports.jsx that broke the entire Reports page). After fix, all 9 requested flows PASS (PO timeline+attachments, Estimate price-book selector+margin warning banner, Customer Proposal preview + PDF with NO cost leaks, Job costing overrun alert + snapshot history/dialog, Reports CSV exports for all 4 tabs, Settings branding + Margin policy save, Sales RBAC).

action_items: None — critical Reports.jsx import bug already fixed by testing agent. Please review and keep the fix (added `import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'`) — without it the entire /reports route crashes for management roles.
critical_code_review_comments: Reports.jsx used <Button> in ExportBtn without importing it — no lint/CI catch. Consider enabling `no-undef` ESLint rule with react plugin so this fails at build time. This exact pattern (JSX identifier without import) is invisible to React until render.

ProposalPreview.jsx correctly restricts fields to description/qty/unit/unit_price/line_total/subtotal/tax/total + optional terms/footer/logo — good customer-safe design. Backend must also enforce this on GET /api/quotes/{id}/proposal (spot-checked payload keys server-side would be reassuring).

JobCosting.jsx `costing-alert-overrun` correctly gated on summary.alerts.over_budget and displays both material_overrun_amount and other_overrun_amount when set. Money component and Snapshot dialog reuse are clean.

EstimateEditor.jsx price-book flow: dialog is only opened when preview returns rows; the toast-only path for zero matching lines is a nice UX touch. Consider exposing reprice-preview response count in the toast for clarity.

Settings.jsx branding + margin cards are cleanly split; MarginPolicySettings percentages are stored as strings from Input — verify backend coerces to number to avoid `"40"` vs `40` comparison bugs downstream.

rca of the issue: Reports.jsx imported Loader2/Lock/BarChart3/Download/Badge/Tabs/Table but omitted `Button` (needed by ExportBtn). React attempted to render <Button> in each TabsContent → ReferenceError bubbled to the runtime error overlay, blanking the whole /reports route. Fix: add `import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'`. Reproduction: log in as owner, visit /reports; overlay says 'Uncaught runtime errors: Button is not defined at ExportBtn'. Mitigation applied. Recommend adding no-undef ESLint rule to prevent recurrence.
